data.description: You've built your glamour, fashion, confidence, and sex appeal to a point where it's not only unmistakable, it can almost be thought of as a weapon. You gain a +2 bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy. Treat your caster level as 1 higher for the purposes of determining the duration of any enchantment spell you cast.
data.name: Idolised
